articles.title: Wi-Fi or Internet Connection Problems
solutions: Check whether Wi-Fi is enabled.
Verify that the device is connected to the correct network.
Restart the computer.
Check whether other devices can access the internet.
Contact IT support if the problem continues.

articles.title: Password and Login Problems
solutions: Verify the username.
Check Caps Lock and keyboard layout.
Use the approved password reset process.
Contact IT support if the account is locked.

articles.title: Slow Computer Troubleshooting
solutions: Restart the computer.
Open Task Manager and check CPU and memory usage.
Close unnecessary applications.
Check available disk space.
Contact IT support if performance does not improve.

articles.title: Printer Troubleshooting
solutions: Check that the printer is powered on.
Verify the printer connection.
Check paper and toner levels.
Inspect the print queue for stuck jobs.
Contact IT support if printing still fails.

articles.title: Email and Outlook Troubleshooting
solutions: Check the internet connection.
Verify the email service status.
Check the mailbox storage limit.
Restart the email application.
Contact IT support if emails are still not working.
